frames.alt: A thin orange crescent of the partially eclipsed sun against a black sky.
A person sitting in a golden wheat field, with trees and a white house behind and people watching in the distance.
A crowd gathered on a field of stubble, sitting and standing in the evening light with houses behind them.
People sitting and walking across a sunlit field, the bright sun low over the trees.
Two young men in caps looking up through eclipse glasses, with more people behind them in the field.
A young man smoking and looking up, beside a woman and a man checking a camera.
A man in a black shirt holding eclipse glasses to his eyes against a blue sky, people taking photos behind him.
A woman in a black top looking up at the sky through eclipse glasses.
A girl in a light dress walking across the field while a man behind her looks up through eclipse glasses.
Long evening shadows across the field as people stand and watch the sky, apartment blocks behind them.
